subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Reconhecer a estrutura de hipertexto em textos de divulgação científica e proceder à remissão a conceitos e relações por meio de notas de rodapés ou boxes.

components.description_pt: Identificar características estruturais de hipertexto em textos de divulgação científica
components.description_en: Identify hypertext structural features in popular science texts
components.cc_component_description: Interpret complex text structures and features common to science and technical genres

components.description_pt: Reconhecer como notas de rodapé funcionam para referenciar conceitos em textos científicos
components.description_en: Recognize how footnotes function to cross-reference concepts in science texts

components.description_pt: Reconhecer como boxes estabelecem relações entre ideias em textos informativos
components.description_en: Recognize how sidebars establish relationships between ideas in informational texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify common text features such as headings, sidebars, and hyperlinks in informational texts

components.description_pt: Usar referências cruzadas para conectar conceitos relacionados em seções de hipertexto
components.description_en: Use cross-references to connect related concepts across sections of a hypertext
components.cc_component_description: Explain how an author builds connections between ideas across sections of an informational text

cc_matches.description: Use text features and search tools (e.g., key words, sidebars, hyperlinks) to locate information relevant to a given topic efficiently.
By the end of grade 12, read and comprehend science/technical texts in the grades 11—CCR text complexity band independently and proficiently.

Analyze how the author unfolds an analysis or series of ideas or events, including the order in which the points are made, how they are introduced and developed, and the connections that are drawn between them.
